summary.business_type: WordPress plugin / SaaS product marketing site
top_findings: Soft-404s site-wide: all unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with 404 content
/docs nav link 301s to /docs/ which returns 403 Forbidden
Trailing-slash URLs (/features/) return 500 Internal Server Error
No sitemap.xml; identical meta description on all 7 pages; zero JSON-LD
quick_wins: Add app/sitemap.js to the static export
Add SoftwareApplication, FAQPage and Organization JSON-LD
Add canonical + Open Graph tags via Next Metadata API
Fix .htaccess: real 404 status, HTTPS redirect, /docs/ rewrite

findings.title: Soft-404s site-wide (HTTP 200 for missing pages)
findings.description: Verified: /about, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /nonexistent-xyz-test all return 200 with 404 page HTML. The 404 page is served with a 200 status for every unknown path.
findings.recommendation: Configure Apache ErrorDocument 404 /404.html (or equivalent) and remove any catch-all rewrite so missing URLs return a real 404 status.

findings.title: Docs navigation broken: /docs 301 -> /docs/ -> 403
findings.description: Export produced docs.html and docs/installation.html but no docs/index.html. The primary nav and footer Docs links end in a 403 Forbidden page.
findings.recommendation: Add an .htaccess rewrite from /docs to docs.html, or ship a docs/index.html.

findings.title: Trailing-slash URLs return 500
findings.description: /features/ returns a 500 Internal Server Error (Apache rewrite/.htaccess issue); slash variants are neither canonicalized nor redirected.
findings.recommendation: Fix the rewrite rules; 301-redirect /page/ to /page.

findings.title: No HTTP to HTTPS redirect
findings.description: http://reviewkit.gutensuite.net/ serves 200 directly, splitting signals and allowing insecure access.
findings.recommendation: 301-redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS (.htaccess or Cloudflare Always Use HTTPS).

findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.description: /sitemap.xml serves the 404 page with a 200 status.
findings.recommendation: Add app/sitemap.js to the Next.js static export and submit it in Search Console.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy on any response.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via Cloudflare or .htaccess, starting with HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options.

findings.title: AI training crawlers blocked by Cloudflare-managed robots.txt
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and similar are disallowed with ai-train=no; search crawlers are allowed.
findings.recommendation: Deliberate policy choice; consider allowing AI search/retrieval bots if AI citations are wanted.

findings.title: No About/team page (thin E-E-A-T)
findings.description: No author, company or team identity anywhere on a site selling a paid plugin.
findings.recommendation: Add an About page with the builder's identity and support policy.

findings.title: Docs section has one article
findings.description: Only 'Installation' exists; shortcode usage, styling and caching topics are missing and are high-intent searches.
findings.recommendation: Add docs articles for shortcodes, widget builder, styling and caching.

findings.title: Showcase is image-only
findings.description: Five screenshots with one-word labels and no supporting text.
findings.recommendation: Add one descriptive paragraph per layout with use-case context.

findings.title: Testimonials minimal
findings.description: Two one-line quotes with no attribution or links.
findings.recommendation: Use real names/sites or link to WordPress.org reviews.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles with good pattern and lengths

findings.title: Identical meta description on all 7 pages
findings.description: Every page uses 'Show your Trustpilot reviews on WordPress. No API keys, no code, no slowdowns.'
findings.recommendation: Write page-specific descriptions via the Next Metadata API.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: No rel=canonical on any page, combined with trailing-slash and HTTP duplicate variants.
findings.recommendation: Set metadataBase in app/layout.js and add alternates.canonical per page.

findings.title: No Open Graph or Twitter cards
findings.description: Shared links render bare on social/chat platforms.
findings.recommendation: Add openGraph and twitter metadata plus a 1200x630 og:image.

findings.title: Duplicated Changelog link in mobile menu
findings.description: Mobile panel lists /changelog twice.
findings.recommendation: Remove the duplicate link in the nav component.

findings.title: Zero JSON-LD on any page
findings.description: No structured data found across all 8 crawled pages.
findings.recommendation: Add SoftwareApplication with offers, FAQPage (pricing FAQ is ready-made), Organization, and BreadcrumbList on docs.

findings.title: No CrUX field data available
findings.description: Site likely below CrUX traffic threshold and no Google API credentials configured; CWV assessed from lab inspection only.
findings.recommendation: Connect GSC/CrUX once traffic grows to replace lab estimates with field data.

findings.title: PNG screenshots moderately heavy
findings.description: badges.png 141 KB, grid.png 88 KB; showcase page loads ~400 KB of PNGs.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF.

findings.title: All AI crawlers blocked in robots.txt
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others with ai-train=no, eliminating AI search citation eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Consider allowing AI search/retrieval bots while keeping training bots blocked; add llms.txt if desired.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive alt text on every content image

findings.title: PNG screenshots could be WebP/AVIF
findings.description: badges.png 141 KB, grid.png 88 KB, builder.png 57 KB.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF for 60-80% savings.
